svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Cutting sheet 1 of 3 — 5.9 mm
svg.desc: 420 × 800 mm sheet, 5.9 mm material. Every red line is already pushed 0.1375 mm away from the wood that stays (kerf 0.275 mm), so cut exactly on the line. 33 parts. Units: mm. 25 mm squares, 5.9 mm material. KERF-COMPENSATED (every cut pushed 0.1375 mm off the kept wood) EXCEPT the board's four seams and the three sides of Tortuga's square, which are cut on their nominal line on purpose: one cut makes both faces, so the beam itself is the fit. Cut the board's rim LAST. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
